# nl

Number lines with page and section rules through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/nl input.txt

moonx cli/nl -ba -w 4 -s ': ' input.txt
```

Number nonempty body lines by default. Header, body and footer styles can select all, nonempty, matching or no lines.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-b VALUE`, `--body-numbering VALUE` | Select body style: a (all), t (nonempty), n (none) or pBRE (matching). Default: `t`. |
| `-w VALUE`, `--number-width VALUE` | Set the minimum number field width. Default: `6`. |
| `-s VALUE`, `--number-separator VALUE` | Set the text between the number and line. Default: `"\t"`. |
| `-v VALUE`, `--starting-line-number VALUE` | Set the initial line number. Default: `1`. |
| `-i VALUE`, `--line-increment VALUE` | Set the line-number increment. Default: `1`. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Section delimiters and matching use the command's byte-oriented text profile.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
